name: @hq/web
description: HQ portal + Worker: the owner's inbox (approve, reject, discuss), health board, runs and controls; the API for the iOS app and runners; the MCP server with its OAuth 2.1 endpoints; the hourly scheduler (Cloudflare, D1, R2)

scripts.dev:worker: vite build --mode development && wrangler d1 migrations apply hq --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply hq --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.upload-version: vite build && wrangler versions upload --env production
